integrity: Analytical proof of asymptotic; 87 reproducibility diagnostics are illustrative, not a substitute for proof. No external mathematical validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The asymptotic requires a Zipf-normalized, separated affine expanding map; it does not cover arbitrary nonlinear countable maps, other truncation renormalizations, or the signed second order at the exact cutoff threshold. Classical conformal-IFS pressure formula is prior work. Equivalence with older specific double-scaling studies cannot be ruled out.
title: Exponential-alphabet crossover for Zipf-normalized expanding maps
